g.text: Cie Fermière des chemins de fer tun…

svg.text: 24 firms in 10 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 131 firms, 289 interlocks, 11 components (largest 107). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 39 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
